(async () => {

const TAG = "[CL-ACTION][GOLEM-FIST-WEIGHTED]";

const p = __PAYLOAD;

if (!p) {

console.warn(TAG, "Missing __PAYLOAD.");

return;

}

// --------------------------------------------------

// Resolve attacker

// --------------------------------------------------

const attackerUuid =

p?.meta?.attackerUuid ??

p?.attackerUuid ??

"";

const attackerDoc = await fromUuid(attackerUuid);

const attackerActor = attackerDoc?.actor ?? attackerDoc;

if (!attackerActor) {

console.warn(TAG, "Could not resolve attacker actor.", { attackerUuid });

return;

}

// --------------------------------------------------

// Read attacker Defense score

// Data key: actor.system.props.defense

// --------------------------------------------------

const rawDefense = foundry.utils.getProperty(

attackerActor,

"system.props.defense"

);

const defenseScore = Math.max(0, Number(rawDefense) || 0);

if (defenseScore <= 0) {

console.log(TAG, "No bonus applied. Defense score is 0 or invalid.", {

attacker: attackerActor.name,

rawDefense

});

return;

}

// --------------------------------------------------

// Add Defense as flat bonus damage

// --------------------------------------------------

p.advPayload = p.advPayload || {};

const beforeBonus = Number(p.advPayload.bonus ?? 0) || 0;

p.advPayload.bonus = beforeBonus + defenseScore;

// Optional debug marker

p.meta = p.meta || {};

p.meta.golemFistWeightedBonus = {

source: "defense",

rawDefense,

defenseScore,

bonusBefore: beforeBonus,

bonusAfter: p.advPayload.bonus

};

console.log(TAG, "APPLIED Defense as flat bonus damage.", {

attacker: attackerActor.name,

rawDefense,

defenseScore,

bonusBefore: beforeBonus,

bonusAfter: p.advPayload.bonus

});

})();
